Working process

Craft with meticulous planning.

Good product design is a connected sequence: learn what matters, identify the signal, make the interaction tangible and improve it with evidence.

01

Research

Gather needs, context and constraints through user research and surveys.

02

Analyse

Turn observations into priorities, journeys and a practical strategy.

03

Prototype

Make the solution tangible with flows, wireframes and interactive UI.

04

Test & iterate

Validate usability, learn quickly and refine the experience in cycles.
